tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background (warm paper / deep plum). The ground every text token is checked against.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Raised areas: cards, panels, table header row, inline code. Takes text, muted and accent-text.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: Hairlines: dividers between sections, rows and list items; header and footer rules. Decorative only, never the sole boundary of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Stronger hairline: outline cards and panels, secondary button border, table header rule.

tokens.name: field-line
tokens.usage: Input and checkbox borders; at least 3:1 on field and bg in both themes (WCAG 1.4.11). Use this for controls, not line-strong.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Body copy and headings on bg, surface, tint and field (4.5:1+ in both themes).

tokens.name: lead
tokens.usage: Intro paragraphs and secondary copy (card bodies, descriptions) on bg and tint.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Labels, meta, dates, eyebrows, footers and placeholders on bg, surface, tint and field.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Amethyst, the brand hue: focus ring (3:1 on bg and field), current navigation item, accent button fill (with on-strong text), highlighted tags, the logo cursor.

tokens.name: accent-text
tokens.usage: Accent as text: inline links and accent eyebrows on bg, surface and tint. Darker than accent in light so small text holds 4.5:1.

tokens.name: accent2
tokens.usage: Second hue, slate blue: secondary categories and tags on bg. Never blended with accent.

tokens.name: strong
tokens.usage: Inverted fill: primary button, selected segment or filter, skip link. Text on it is on-strong.

tokens.name: on-strong
tokens.usage: Text on strong and on accent fills (primary and accent buttons, solid tags).

tokens.name: code
tokens.usage: Terminal background: streamed output, logs and CLI views. Dark in both themes. Editors use field instead.

tokens.name: code-text
tokens.usage: Terminal text on code.

tokens.name: tint
tokens.usage: Highlight fill: accent card, featured item, text selection, confirmation notices. Takes text, lead, muted and accent-text.

tokens.name: tint-line
tokens.usage: Border of tint surfaces.

tokens.name: field
tokens.usage: Input and textarea background. Takes text and muted (placeholder).

tokens.name: syn-key
tokens.usage: Editors: object keys and property names on field. Follows the theme; 4.5:1 on field in both themes.

tokens.name: syn-string
tokens.usage: Editors: string values and plain code text on field. Follows the theme; 4.5:1 on field in both themes.

tokens.name: syn-number
tokens.usage: Editors: numbers, booleans and null on field. Follows the theme; 4.5:1 on field in both themes.

tokens.name: syn-punct
tokens.usage: Editors: brackets, commas, colons, comments and line numbers on field. Follows the theme; 4.5:1 on field in both themes.

tokens.name: error
tokens.usage: Errors and alerts on bg; invalid input border on field. Always paired with a written message, never colour alone.

tokens.name: error-tint
tokens.usage: Fill behind error callouts and error rows. Takes text and error (4.5:1+ in both themes).

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Success and connected states: icons and short text on bg, surface, field and success-tint. Always with a written word, never colour alone.

tokens.name: success-tint
tokens.usage: Fill behind success callouts. Takes text and success.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Warnings: something needs attention but nothing failed. Icons and text on bg, surface, field and warning-tint.

tokens.name: warning-tint
tokens.usage: Fill behind warning callouts. Takes text and warning.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Neutral information and hints: icons and text on bg, surface, field and info-tint.

tokens.name: info-tint
tokens.usage: Fill behind info callouts. Takes text and info.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Overlay behind modal dialogs. Popovers and menus get no scrim.

tokens.name: term-line
tokens.usage: Console views: title bar rule and scrollbar track. Dark in both themes.

tokens.name: term-text
tokens.usage: Console views: command and output text on code.

tokens.name: term-lead
tokens.usage: Console views: emphasised output on code.

tokens.name: term-muted
tokens.usage: Console views: muted output (meta lines, hints) on code.

tokens.name: term-placeholder
tokens.usage: Console views: input placeholder on code.

tokens.name: term-prompt
tokens.usage: Console views: the prompt and the focus ring on code.

tokens.name: term-link
tokens.usage: Console views: links and paths on code.

tokens.name: term-dot
tokens.usage: Console views: window dots in the title bar (decorative).

tokens.name: term-error
tokens.usage: Console views: error lines on code.

families.sans: "Space Grotesk", "Space Grotesk Fallback", system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", sans-serif
families.mono: "JetBrains Mono", "JetBrains Mono Fallback", ui-monospace, "SFMono-Regular", Menlo, Consolas, monospace

styles.name: t-display
styles.usage: Largest headline on marketing pages, one per page at most. Fluid: --fs-display, 48px at 390 → 96px at 1440.

styles.name: t-h1
styles.usage: Page title (h1) on marketing and content pages. Fluid 40 → 64px (--fs-h1).

styles.name: t-h2
styles.usage: Section titles; the page title in application screens. Fluid 32 → 40px (--fs-h2).

styles.name: t-h3
styles.usage: Card, panel and sub-section headings. Fluid 20 → 24px (--fs-h3). Medium, not bold.

styles.name: t-lead
styles.sample: Everything you need to run the project in one place.
styles.usage: Intro paragraph under a page title, in lead. Fluid 18 → 22px (--fs-lead).

styles.name: t-body
styles.sample: Changes are saved automatically and synced to your team.
styles.usage: Running copy (--fs-body). UI line height is 1.6; long-form prose uses 1.75.

styles.name: t-ui
styles.usage: Navigation, buttons, tables, form controls and dense UI (--fs-ui). Set font-size: var(--fs-ui).

styles.name: t-small
styles.usage: Secondary notes under cards, fields and items (--fs-small).

styles.name: t-label
styles.usage: Dates, IDs, meta lines and field hints, in muted (--fs-label).

styles.name: t-eyebrow
styles.usage: UPPERCASE mono eyebrow (text-transform: uppercase): card titles, table headers, group labels, in muted (--fs-tag).

styles.name: t-accent
styles.usage: Italic mono accent inside a heading or line, at the surrounding size, in accent. Once per screen.

tokens.name: grid-gap
tokens.usage: Gap between cards, panels and grid columns.

tokens.name: touch
tokens.usage: Minimum size of every interactive target (buttons, links in menus, toggles, checkboxes rows). WCAG 2.5.8 floor is 24px; the brand standard is 44px.

tokens.name: content-max
tokens.usage: Max width of page content; the side gutter grows to centre it (20px on phones → 160px at 1440).

tokens.name: prose-max
tokens.usage: Reading column for long-form text (articles, documentation, legal pages).

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs, inline code, small chips.

tokens.name: radius
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, code blocks.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Large panels, dialogs and console windows.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, tags and segmented controls: every button is a pill.

fontSize.note: Fluid sizes behind the type styles; use these variables in CSS rather than fixed px.
